# Quartermaster API (/)

Quartermaster is a procurement agent for restaurants. An owner writes _"We're expecting a busy
weekend. Restock takeaway containers and cooking oil without exceeding $300."_ The agent
forecasts demand, compares suppliers with Channel3 market prices and proposes carts.
**TrustRail** checks every cart in code against the owner's Spend Mandate, blocking hidden fees
and prompt-injected listings. PayPal then captures payment only after the owner approves one exact,
signed cart.

This portal, the TypeScript and Python SDKs and the agent-friendly docs are generated by APIMatic
from the API's [OpenAPI 3.1 spec](https://github.com/pranavsaji/quartermaster-ai/blob/main/docs/openapi.json).
A contract test checks that spec against the API's real responses.

<Cards>

<Card title="Quickstart" href="/quickstart">
  Sign in, read stock and the Spend Mandate, and ask the agent to restock: in about 30 lines of TypeScript.
</Card>

<Card title="SDKs" href="/sdks">
  Typed TypeScript and Python clients, with the session cookie and server environments built in.
</Card>

<Card title="API Reference">Every endpoint, with SDK code samples and a live playground against the hosted demo.</Card>

<Card title="Agent-Friendly Docs" href="/llms.txt" external>
  `llms.txt` and Markdown pages, so coding agents can integrate correctly.
</Card>

</Cards>

## Conventions [#conventions]

- **Money** is always integer minor units (cents): fields end in `_minor`.
- **Sign-in** sets an httpOnly session cookie: `__Host-qm_session` on the hosted demo, `qm_session` locally.
- **Every mutation** sends `X-Requested-With: quartermaster` (CSRF guard). Approval and payment calls
  also take an `Idempotency-Key`, so a retry never pays twice.
- **Errors** share one shape, `ApiError`, with a stable `code` and a fixed message.
- **Roles:** owners approve and pay, managers request and research, viewers read.
- **Payments** run in the PayPal sandbox only. No real money moves.

## Try it [#try-it]

The hosted demo is at [quartermaster-web-o0df.onrender.com](https://quartermaster-web-o0df.onrender.com).
Create an account with sample data, or use the shared sample workspace listed in the
[README](https://github.com/pranavsaji/quartermaster-ai#for-judges).


# Quickstart (/quickstart)

This walk-through uses the TypeScript SDK in
[`apimatic/sdk/typescript`](https://github.com/pranavsaji/quartermaster-ai/tree/main/apimatic/sdk/typescript).
The complete script is
[`apimatic/examples/quickstart.mjs`](https://github.com/pranavsaji/quartermaster-ai/blob/main/apimatic/examples/quickstart.mjs).

## 1. Build the SDK [#1-build-the-sdk]

```bash
cd apimatic/sdk/typescript
npm install && npm run build
```

## 2. Sign in [#2-sign-in]

Sign-in returns the user and sets the session cookie. Read the cookie from the response headers,
then create a client that sends it.

```ts
import { QuartermasterAiTrustRailApiClient, ServerEnvironment } from "quartermaster-ai-trust-rail-api";

const anonymous = new QuartermasterAiTrustRailApiClient({ serverEnvironment: ServerEnvironment.Hosted });
const signedIn = await anonymous.accountsApi.login({ xRequestedWith: "quartermaster", body: { email, password } }).asApiResult();
if (!signedIn.ok) throw new Error(signedIn.error.message);

const token = signedIn.headers
  .getSetCookie()
  .map((c) => /qm_session=([^;]+)/.exec(c)?.[1])
  .find(Boolean);
const client = new QuartermasterAiTrustRailApiClient({ serverEnvironment: ServerEnvironment.Hosted, secureSession: token });
```

Use `ServerEnvironment.Local` with `session: token` against a local API (`pnpm dev`).

## 3. Read stock and the Spend Mandate [#3-read-stock-and-the-spend-mandate]

```ts
const { items } = await client.inventoryApi.listInventory();
const { mandate, budget } = await client.trustRail.getSpendMandate();
console.log(`${budget.remainingMinor / 100} left of ${budget.limitMinor / 100} this week`);
```

## 4. Ask the agent [#4-ask-the-agent]

```ts
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";

const request = await client.procurement.createProcurementRequest({
  xRequestedWith: "quartermaster",
  idempotencyKey: randomUUID(),
  body: { instruction: "We're expecting a busy weekend. Restock takeaway containers and cooking oil without exceeding $300." },
});
const researched = await client.procurement.researchProcurementRequest({ id: request.id, xRequestedWith: "quartermaster" });

for (const p of researched.proposals) {
  console.log(p.status, p.supplierName, p.totalMinor / 100);
  for (const v of p.policyDecision?.violations ?? []) console.log("  ", v.code, v.message);
}
```

On the sample data this prints TrustRail blocking QuickServe Packaging Co. with
`QUARANTINED_SOURCE` (its listing tells AI agents to skip approval) and `UNAUTHORIZED_LINE_ITEM`
(a hidden $24.50 "priority service charge"), and proposing Harbor Restaurant Supply for $173.20.

## 5. Approve and pay [#5-approve-and-pay]

Approval (`approveProcurementRequest`) needs the **owner** role and the cart hash the owner saw.
Payment then goes through PayPal's checkout in the browser, so open the request in the web app to
finish. The API never lets an agent pay on its own.


# SDKs (/sdks)

- [TypeScript](/sdks/typescript): [Download SDK](/__downloads/sdk/typescript.zip)
- [Python](/sdks/python): [Download SDK](/__downloads/sdk/python.zip)

# Python SDK (/sdks/python)

[Download SDK](/__downloads/sdk/python.zip)

## Intro [#intro]

The Quartermaster AI + TrustRail API SDK provides access to the Quartermaster AI + TrustRail API REST APIs.

Autonomous procurement secured by TrustRail. Amounts are integer minor units (cents). Sign in with `POST /auth/login` (or `/auth/signup`): the API sets an httpOnly session cookie. Every mutation requires the header `X-Requested-With: quartermaster`; routes marked idempotent also require an `Idempotency-Key`. Errors share one shape (`ApiError`) with a stable `code`.

## Installation [#installation]

Add the SDK to your project from its folder, with whichever package manager your project uses. Give each tool a path containing a slash, such as `../quartermaster-ai-trust-rail-api` — a bare folder name is looked up on PyPI instead, and resolves to whatever project holds that name there:

```bash
pip install <path-to-sdk>
```

```bash
uv add <path-to-sdk>
```

```bash
poetry add <path-to-sdk>
```

## Quick Start [#quick-start]

### Synchronous client [#synchronous-client]

Construct `QuartermasterAiTrustRailApiClient` with keyword arguments, and call `close()` when you are done. Every argument is optional.

```python
from quartermaster_ai_trust_rail_api import QuartermasterAiTrustRailApiClient

client = QuartermasterAiTrustRailApiClient(session="YOUR_API_KEY", secure_session="YOUR_API_KEY", environment="hosted")

client.close()
```

Alternatively, scope it — `with QuartermasterAiTrustRailApiClient(...) as client:` closes the pool on exit.

### Asynchronous client [#asynchronous-client]

`AsyncQuartermasterAiTrustRailApiClient` mirrors `QuartermasterAiTrustRailApiClient` with **identical method names**, and every endpoint method is a coroutine. It takes the same arguments, with some differences — for example, the transport argument is `custom_async_http_client`.

```python
from asyncio import run

from quartermaster_ai_trust_rail_api import AsyncQuartermasterAiTrustRailApiClient

async def main() -> None:
    client = AsyncQuartermasterAiTrustRailApiClient(
        session="YOUR_API_KEY", secure_session="YOUR_API_KEY", environment="hosted"
    )
    await client.aclose()

run(main())
```

Alternatively, scope it — `async with AsyncQuartermasterAiTrustRailApiClient(...) as client:` closes the pool on exit.

# TypeScript SDK (/sdks/typescript)

[Download SDK](/__downloads/sdk/typescript.zip)

## Intro [#intro]

The Quartermaster AI + TrustRail API SDK provides access to the Quartermaster AI + TrustRail API REST APIs.

Autonomous procurement secured by TrustRail. Amounts are integer minor units (cents). Sign in with `POST /auth/login` (or `/auth/signup`): the API sets an httpOnly session cookie. Every mutation requires the header `X-Requested-With: quartermaster`; routes marked idempotent also require an `Idempotency-Key`. Errors share one shape (`ApiError`) with a stable `code`.

## Installation [#installation]

The SDK compiles to `dist/` before it can be referenced — run its `build` script once in the SDK folder, then add it to your project by path:

```bash
npm install <path-to-sdk>
```

## Quick Start [#quick-start]

Create one client and reuse it. Configure its behaviour through `ClientOptions`.

```ts
import { QuartermasterAiTrustRailApiClient, ServerEnvironment } from "quartermaster-ai-trust-rail-api";

const client = new QuartermasterAiTrustRailApiClient({
  serverEnvironment: ServerEnvironment.Hosted,
  session: "YOUR_API_KEY",
  secureSession: "YOUR_API_KEY",
});
```

Nothing in `ClientOptions` is required — `new QuartermasterAiTrustRailApiClient()` compiles — and each option left out falls back to its default. `serverEnvironment` is spelled out above so the environment a call reaches is visible where the client is built rather than inherited silently.

### From CommonJS [#from-commonjs]

The package ships both dialects from a single entry, so `require` works with full types. In a TypeScript CommonJS file use the `import ... = require(...)` form — a plain destructuring `require` runs fine but gives you `any`.

```ts
import sdk = require("quartermaster-ai-trust-rail-api");

const client = new sdk.QuartermasterAiTrustRailApiClient({
  serverEnvironment: sdk.ServerEnvironment.Hosted,
  session: "YOUR_API_KEY",
  secureSession: "YOUR_API_KEY",
});
```

# Feature flags and PayPal client id (/api/openapi/system/getPublicConfig)

`GET /config/public`

Feature flags and PayPal client id.

# Report a browser error to error tracking (/api/openapi/system/reportClientError)

`POST /client-errors`

Report a browser error to error tracking.

# Sign in (sets httpOnly session cookie) (/api/openapi/accounts/login)

`POST /auth/login`

Sign in (sets httpOnly session cookie).

# Create a workspace and its owner (sets session cookie) (/api/openapi/accounts/signup)

`POST /auth/signup`

Create a workspace and its owner (sets session cookie).

# Email a password reset link (always 202) (/api/openapi/accounts/requestPasswordReset)

`POST /auth/password/forgot`

Email a password reset link (always 202).

# Set a new password from a one-time link (/api/openapi/accounts/resetPassword)

`POST /auth/password/reset`

Set a new password from a one-time link.

# Change your password (signs out other sessions) (/api/openapi/accounts/changePassword)

`POST /auth/password/change`

Change your password (signs out other sessions).

# Sign out (/api/openapi/accounts/logout)

`POST /auth/logout`

Sign out.

# Current user and organization (/api/openapi/accounts/getCurrentUser)

`GET /auth/me`

Current user and organization.

# Preview an invitation from its link token (/api/openapi/team/lookupInvitation)

`POST /invitations/lookup`

Preview an invitation from its link token.

# Accept an invitation, create the account and sign in (/api/openapi/team/acceptInvitation)

`POST /invitations/accept`

Accept an invitation, create the account and sign in.

# Members, and open invitations for owners (/api/openapi/team/listMembers)

`GET /members`

Members, and open invitations for owners.

# Invite someone (returns the one-time link; emailed when email is configured) (/api/openapi/team/inviteMember)

`POST /members/invitations`

Invite someone (returns the one-time link; emailed when email is configured). Requires the OWNER role.

# Revoke an open invitation (/api/openapi/team/revokeInvitation)

`POST /members/invitations/{id}/revoke`

Revoke an open invitation. Requires the OWNER role.

# Change a member's role (a workspace keeps at least one owner) (/api/openapi/team/updateMemberRole)

`PUT /members/{id}/role`

Change a member's role (a workspace keeps at least one owner). Requires the OWNER role.

# Remove a member (/api/openapi/team/removeMember)

`POST /members/{id}/remove`

Remove a member. Requires the OWNER role.

# Issue a one-time password reset link for a member (/api/openapi/team/issueMemberResetLink)

`POST /members/{id}/password-reset`

Issue a one-time password reset link for a member. Requires the OWNER role.

# Current stock, usage and alerts (/api/openapi/inventory/listInventory)

`GET /inventory`

Current stock, usage and alerts.

# Add a stock item (/api/openapi/inventory/createInventoryItem)

`POST /inventory`

Add a stock item. Requires the MANAGER role.

# Record an authorized stock change (/api/openapi/inventory/adjustInventoryItem)

`POST /inventory/{id}/adjustments`

Record an authorized stock change. Requires the MANAGER role. Idempotent: send an `Idempotency-Key`.

# Calculate reorder recommendations (/api/openapi/inventory/forecastInventory)

`POST /inventory/forecast`

Calculate reorder recommendations. Requires the MANAGER role.

# Update a stock item's details (not its quantity) (/api/openapi/inventory/updateInventoryItem)

`PUT /inventory/{id}`

Update a stock item's details (not its quantity). Requires the MANAGER role.

# Suppliers with mandate approval and catalog size (/api/openapi/suppliers/listSuppliers)

`GET /suppliers`

Suppliers with mandate approval and catalog size.

# Add a supplier (owners approve it in the Spend Mandate) (/api/openapi/suppliers/createSupplier)

`POST /suppliers`

Add a supplier (owners approve it in the Spend Mandate). Requires the MANAGER role.

# Supplier with its catalog (/api/openapi/suppliers/getSupplier)

Supplier with its catalog.

`POST /procurement/requests`

`POST /procurement/requests/{id}/evaluate`

`POST /procurement/requests/{id}/approve`

Approve an exact cart, sign an Intent Certificate and reserve budget. Requires the OWNER role. Idempotent: send an `Idempotency-Key`.

`POST /procurement/requests/{id}/reject`

Reject one proposal (purchase_order_id) or every open proposal. Requires the OWNER role.
